verdict.rationale: OCI's first-party docs describe official SDKs for building apps that integrate with OCI services, each with code samples and documentation for creating, testing, and troubleshooting. A Java SDK for Select AI is also documented, and the 12-month advance notice on breaking API changes supports building against these SDKs reliably. Missing for 10: the specific languages covered and SDK depth or versioning details, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.
